column1: # The live guns' iron sights under an optic (the rifle scopes' variants, and scope fits' on these guns;
# make_pack.py, sights.py; docs/notes/weapon_scopes.md, section 7), done as 0.69d0 does them: an optic sets
# a sight module's slot to param 1, its model_param1 (a folded sight, or another module); a sight of the
# gun's own mesh stays. The last column, what a variant's weapon model does (make_pack.py):
#   refold <surface> <up> <folded> <theirs>     0.69d0's up module (<theirs>: its surface), found in <surface>
#                                               by its positions (the port mapped its texture anew), folded
#                                               as 0.69d0's folded one, piece by piece
#   swap <surface> <up> <other>                 the up module found so and taken out; the optic's own model
# (and scope fits' fold, turn, cut, lower: its sights.tsv)
